mineral_product.label: Mineral / product
mineral_product.value: Northern white industrial sand, from coarse 8/16 to fine 100 grain fineness grades

extraction_route.label: Extraction route
extraction_route.value: Company-owned and operated surface sand mines in St. Peter and Wonewoc formations

beneficiation_processing.label: Beneficiation / processing
beneficiation_processing.value: Gradation into size grades, custom blending and in-house packaging, with in-house lab testing of quality properties

delivery_radius_logistics.label: Delivery radius / logistics
delivery_radius_logistics.value: Rail-served shipping via six railroads across USA, Canada and Mexico; truck loading and bulk bags

product_specification_permits.label: Product specification / permits
product_specification_permits.value: Graded industrial sands tested for gradation, pH, loss on ignition, moisture and XRF chemistry; custom blends

notes: Reserve life is not in the evidence; extraction route comes from company knowledge of its surface mines.
